validity.researcher_notes:
EXISTENCE/CLASSIFICATION: real, well-documented Egyptian state gas project, correctly classified as a gas transmission spur. Egypt's Ministry of Petroleum (petroleum.gov.eg, MoP release 28 Dec 2022) and multiple independent trade/news outlets describe a two-phase GASCO project connecting the offshore Raven field (bp-operated, north Alexandria/Rashid area) to two destinations: Phase 1 (P6703 in this roster) = 70km/30in line to the Western Desert Gas Complex (WDGC), operational May 2021, capacity 350 MMcf/d; Phase 2 = a 5km/18in spur to the Al-Amiriya (Amreya) LPG/Butane Extraction Plant, launched 25 Sep 2022, capacity 100 MMcf/d, so that the Amreya butane plant could run at full design capacity. This 5km/18in spur is exactly P6704 -- length, diameter and both endpoint names (Rashid-area source, Ameriya/Alexandria destination) match precisely. Independent corroboration beyond the ministry release: Egypt Oil & Gas (trade press) 'El Molla Gives Green Light for Raven Field Gas Line to Al-Amirya Plant', attaqa.net (Arabic energy trade site) 2022-09-25 'مشروع ربط خط غاز حقل ريفين المصري يدخل مرحلته الثانية', youm7 2022-09-25 launch story, and EgyptToday's companion piece on the WDGC leg. These are genuinely separate outlets (ministry PR + Egyptian trade press + independent news), not one wire story reprinted -- tier high. The already-cited youm7 2023-07-10 article is a later, broader piece revisiting the whole Raven-connection project (mentions both the 70km and 5km legs and a planned 'Phase 3' WDGC capacity increase for Q3 2023); it is fine to keep as a secondary ref but is not the most precise source for this specific 5km/18in/Ameriya segment, which is why its automated content-check for the literal word 'operating' came back empty.
DUPLICATE check: NOT a duplicate of P6703 (Raven-Western Desert Cmplex Gas Pipeline, roster) -- that is the sibling 70km/30in/350 MMcf/d Phase-1 leg to the Western Desert Gas Complex; this row is the physically distinct 5km/18in/100 MMcf/d Phase-2 spur to the Amreya butane plant. Both legs stem from the same Raven-field connection project but are different pipe (different length, diameter, capacity, and destination) and are each entered once -- correctly split, not double-counted. Also checked against GulfPub's Egypt gas roster: GulfPub carries a separate 'Raven - Idku Pipeline' (bp, dia 16in, 46km, 2021) -- this is a THIRD, physically distinct line (Raven field to the Idku onshore gas/LNG complex, not to Amreya) and is not represented under P6704 or, as far as this roster shows, under any other GEM ProjectID in the Egypt gas operating set. That is a possible discovery gap worth a separate look, but it is not a duplicate concern for P6704 itself.
ATTRIBUTION: sheet Owner1 = 'Egyptian Natural Gas Holding Co' (EGAS) 100%, identical to sibling P6703. All sources name GASCO (Egyptian Natural Gas Company, an EGAS subsidiary) as the entity that built/owns/operates this specific line ('نفذته جاسكو' -- 'implemented by GASCO'). The GGIT schema has no separate Operator column, so recording the parent state holding company as Owner is the same convention used across this whole Egypt-gas sub-network (all EGAS-system rows) -- not treated as an error, but noting GASCO as the operating subsidiary for the record.
SPEC: Diameter 18in and Length 5.00km both match every source exactly. Capacity (currently blank in the sheet) is well-sourced at 100 MMcf/d and is staged as a fill below.

Note CapacityUnits should be 'MMcf/d' (million cf/day) to match the sheet's own unit convention used elsewhere (e.g. P0061, P0143) -- flagging in passing that sibling P6703's CapacityUnits is currently recorded as 'Mcf/d' for its 350 which is very likely a units typo for 'MMcf/d' (350 million cf/day per the same sources), out of scope for this P6704 row but worth a follow-up fix on P6703.

StartMonth1 was blank; both dated 25 Sep 2022 sources report the operational launch ceremony ('وزير البترول يعطي إشارة بدء التشغيل') for this specific Amreya spur on that date. StartYear1=2022 already matched and is unchanged; adding the month for precision.

routes.start_name: Tie-in near the Western Desert Gas Complex (GASCO), Amreya industrial zone, Alexandria Governorate
routes.end_name: Al-Amiriya (Amreya) LPG/Butane Extraction Plant, Alexandria Governorate
routes.corridor_desc: This is a short (5km/18in) intra-industrial-zone connector, not a long-haul line from Rashid town on the coast (which is ~40km+ from Alexandria's Amreya district -- far too far for a 5km pipe). Multiple sources (Egypt Oil & Gas, attaqa.net, egyptoil-gas's separate piece on WDGC/Amreya output) place both the Western Desert Gas Complex (WDGC) and the Amreya LPG/butane recovery plant in the same Amreya/Merghem industrial area southwest of Alexandria city, and describe this 5km/18in line as the second phase of the Raven-field connection project -- the first phase (P6703, 70km/30in) already brings Raven-field gas from the coast to the WDGC; this short spur then carries gas the final 5km from that complex to the neighboring Amreya butane plant so it can run at full capacity. GEM's own StartLocation='Rashid' for this row (identical to sibling P6703) most likely reflects the project's field-of-origin naming convention rather than this specific segment's physical starting point. I could not find a source giving an exact facility gate or pipeline-map coordinate for either the WDGC or the Amreya LPG plant, so no lat/lon is given -- only the named facilities and the general Amreya/Merghem, southwest Alexandria vicinity, which is a tight, well-defended bound given the line's short length even without exact coordinates.
routes.researcher_notes: Endpoints are named and sourced (WDGC and the Amreya LPG plant, both in the Amreya/Merghem industrial zone, Alexandria) but no coordinates or route map were found, so lat/lon are left null rather than fabricated. This is a suggestion for a later human routes-repo look, not an applied route; it also flags that the sheet's literal StartLocation='Rashid' likely describes the project's field-of-origin rather than this 5km segment's own footprint.

summary: P6704 confirmed real and correctly classified (5km/18in GASCO spur, Phase 2 of the Raven-field connection project, feeding the Amreya LPG/butane plant; sibling of P6703's 70km/30in Phase-1 line to the Western Desert Gas Complex -- not a duplicate of it or of GulfPub's separate Raven-Idku line); staged fills for blank Capacity (100 MMcf/d), StartMonth1 (9), and orphan Length/Location refs; flagged a likely CapacityUnits typo on sibling P6703 (out of scope here) and a route caveat that this segment's true corridor is a short intra-Amreya-zone connector, not a Rashid-to-Alexandria long-haul.
